text.autoconfig.autologin.title: AutoLogin — Settings
text.autoconfig.autologin.option.servers: Format: play.example.com|NickName=password  (passwords are saved automatically when you log in)
text.autoconfig.autologin.option.trigger: Password is sent when a chat message contains any of these words
text.autoconfig.autologin.option.transfe: Copy this key and paste it into the Import field on another device — all your passwords will transfer automatically.
⚠ NEVER share this key with anyone!
This key contains ALL of your saved passwords.
If someone asks you to send it to them — that is a scammer. Never give your key to anyone.
Paste transfer key here to import
Paste a transfer key generated on your other device and click Save. The passwords will be merged with your current ones.
⚠ NEVER share your own transfer key with anyone!
Only paste keys that you generated yourself on another device.
If someone sent you a key and is asking you to paste it — do not do it. It is a trap.
